GSR2 pre-HUD depth snapshot fallback via compute for sampleable depth without TransferSrc.
Includes frozen R32Sfloat resource, Vulkan synchronization, persistent provenance checks, and automatic source tests.
Build ARM64 Bionic experimental APK. Not a confirmed visual fix without Redmagic validation.

Revision: includes compiled GLSL header gsr2_depth_snapshot_comp.h in vk_temporal_upscaler.cpp.
